title: styrax crotonoides subsp. fraserensis
intro: Styrax crotonoides subsp. fraserensis, commonly known as Fraser's styrax, is a plant species belonging to the Styrax genus, native to the Fraser Island in Australia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various health issues. Bioactive constituents of Fraser's styrax include resinous compounds, including beta-amyrin and styraxol, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
